speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twelfth Day, and you are buttoned for a yard. Eat, before you tell me you are not hungry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not hungry before a play, Mistress. I will take the small beer.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is cut. She put it to the notch and made a face, and then she cut it anyway.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny loaf, a finger short, the same as Friday. I am not preaching a finger I have already measured.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the finger on Friday. I have not come down to argue with the board.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the man in your play hanged, sir? I heard the rope through the floor once, and then I heard people laugh.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is nearly hanged, and then he is not. I have the first speech and the last, and a stool between.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then sit on the stool in your mind, and take three bites here. Board is threepence whether you use it or not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three bites. I will pay the threepence at dinner if I am in. The yard is at two.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Two is a long wait on three bites. At home we would have had the hog in by now. Here you buy it in pieces.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: This is not Hertfordshire, and the hog is already in pieces. Put the beer by him and do not linger for a speech.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am not lingering. I only want to know if the queens are boys. All of them. Even the grave ones.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Some of them are boys. There is one who has played queens since he was eleven. That is a fact of the company, not a speech for the stair.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Keep the company at the Keys. Gillis ate and went to his loom. You may be as quick with your yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I go for two. I am back between the play and Holywell, and out again after, for a cake.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: A cake with a bean in it. Whoever finds the bean is king. Even if he is one of the boys?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Even then. If it is the boy I think, he will be grave about it, and he will not shout.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Grave is cheap. Eating is threepence. If you come in late with ink on the cuff and no supper taken, the board will not have kept a plate patient for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat when I am home from the cake. I am empty before a play. I am not ill.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The cat may have the book. You may have the bread. Three bites, and then the stair is yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three bites, and no plot this morning. You had your say on Friday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I had it, and I will not give it twice before dinner. Go and be nearly hanged, and come back hungry.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Say the short of the rope again, sir, and then I will take the plates.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He tells a long tale of a shipwreck. The rope waits at the end of the tale, and then it does not come.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That is enough stair. Alse, the plates. Master Shakespeare, the threepence is in my head if it is not yet on a paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is in your head, then. I am gone for two.
